title: Replace Itau Unibanco with IREN at 4%, funded by Itau (3%) and 1% of T-bills; severe-tail loss now beyond the -18% limit
reasoning: Owner decision at 01:00 on 12 Oct: swap the 3% Itau position for IREN and take the rest from cash, sized at 4% after Claude argued for 3-4%. His case: IREN controls one of the larger power pipelines in North America and is converting it from bitcoin mining to AI cloud. Checked against IREN's FY26 results (year to 30 Jun 2026): revenue $707.0m, AI cloud $128.8m against $16.4m, AI cloud $70.5m vs mining $66.7m in Q4, contracted annualised revenue $4bn for 2026 capacity against $1bn operating, 45-55% of GPU cost prepaid by customers. Risks: about $7.6bn of debt, $6.3bn of convertible proceeds and $4.7bn of new shares in FY26, a $702.6m net loss including $638.8m of impairments, and non-investment-grade customers financed at 9%. The Anthropic contract is an unconfirmed report from anonymous sources (The Information via AI Weekly, 11 Oct) with no size, term or site, and IREN's reference price is Friday's close before that report, so Monday's open may gap up. Terms: reference $35.19, 150.43 shares planned in total at the reference, a first tranche of GBP 2,000 at Monday's open price (sized in pounds, not shares; skipped and reviewed if the open is more than 10% above the reference, i.e. above $38.71) and the second GBP 2,000 only after IREN or Anthropic confirms the contract and IREN's breakers have not fired; target $44 (+25.0%), review level $28 (-20.4%). IREN is held hedged to sterling. Effect on the cap: the severe-tail loss moves from -17.88% to -19.12% on Claude's assumed IREN shock of -40% (-30% in the AI derating test); with a 1% sterling rise it is about -19.30%. The owner accepted going beyond the -18% limit. Claude's dissent: this swaps an uncorrelated holding for more exposure to the same AI funding cycle, and the confirmed facts support 3% at most until the contract is confirmed. Recorded as an owner override; the -18% figure stays in portfolio.json as the stated limit with a capStatus note. The reserve rule still requires any further deployment to be funded by an equal cut elsewhere. Owner decision 12 Oct: keep IREN at 4% and accept the severe-tail breach (limit unchanged). Evidence (Alpha Vantage weekly adjusted closes for IREN, Jun 2025 to 9 Oct 2026, retrieved 12 Oct): the worst 4-week fall was -43.9%, the worst 8-week fall -41.7%, and the deepest peak-to-trough on weekly closes was -47.1% (63.54 on 29 May to 33.62 on 17 Jul 2026), so the -40% severe and -30% derating shocks are not above what the stock has already done.
whatWouldChangeMyMind: Confirmation of the Anthropic contract with terms (would support the second half), denial or no contract by the next company update, a cut to the $4bn ARR target, or a convertible or equity raise diluting holders by more than 10% (each would end the case).
